gitCommit.subject: authz: close cross-tenant IDOR holes (pv9 PR1) (#235)
gitCommit.body:
authz: close cross-tenant IDOR holes (pv9 PR1) (#235)

* docs(authz): pv9 design spec — Owner/Curator collapse, DAL chokepoint, IDOR + correctness fixes

Re-derived from current code (the epic's referenced plan doc is gone). Capability
map confirmed by owner: full-curator, owner-only admin, purge-on-account-delete.
Expand/contract migration so no merge forces a destructive prod migration.

Refs: purses-pv9

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(authz): fold adversarial-review findings into pv9 spec

ownerId is the sole owner source (role display-only) — kills the dual-source drift
+ role mass-assignment escalation. Expand-only this epic: keep inert flag columns/types
(no compile break, no destructive migration); contract deferred to a follow-up bead.
accept binds to DB-canonical email + unique-index idempotency. Account-deletion enumerates
the borrowed-collection child-first order + emailVerified/verificationToken scrub. errorResponse
sweep in one PR; route-enumeration test asserts filesystem-exhaustiveness; ESLint boundary deferred.

Follow-ups filed: purses-us3d, purses-25ca, purses-wfgj, purses-opir. Refs: purses-pv9

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(authz): pv9 implementation plan — 6 PRs, task-by-task

Refs: purses-pv9

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): scope /api/items/[id] to collection access (IDOR, purses-3al)

GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/items/[id] were requireAuth-only — any authenticated
user could read/edit/delete any item cross-tenant. Resolve the item, 404 if
absent, then gate on requireApiCollectionAccess(item.collectionId) before the
op. Body parse stays after authz on PATCH. Flipped the three IDOR pins to
403 + unchanged-state.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): scope /api/items POST + restore to collection (IDOR, purses-3al)

POST /api/items gates the query-param collectionId via requireApiCollectionAccess
before parsing the body or creating the item. /items/[id]/restore resolves the
item (incl. soft-deleted) → 404 if absent → collection-access gate → restore;
absent item now 404 instead of a 500 from an UPDATE returning() TypeError.
Flipped items-POST stranger 201→403+no-row and restore stranger 200→403+still-
deleted and restore-absent 500→404 pins.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): require collection access on GET collection + members (IDOR, purses-55c)

GET /api/collections/[id] and GET …/members were requireAuth-only — any
authenticated user could read any collection or its member roster. Both now run
requireApiCollectionAccess (resolve collection → 404 absent → 403 non-member)
before the controller call. Absent collection on GET now 404 (was a 500 from the
controller throwing "Collection not found"). Flipped GET-absent 500→404, added a
stranger→403 GET test, and flipped members stranger 200→403.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): scope invitations/[id]+resend to collection; 404 on absent (purses-nj7)

GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/invitations/[id] and POST …/resend were requireAuth-only
(cross-tenant IDOR). Each now resolves the invitation → 404 if absent → gates on
requireApiCollectionAccess(invitation.collectionId) (member-or-owner; the
owner-only tightening is PR4) before the op. PATCH parses the body after authz.
Ride-along: archive/restore resolve the collection first so an absent id is a
clean 404 instead of a 403 from canManageCollection(findById→null). Flipped four
nj7 stranger pins 200→403 (+state), three absent-invitation pins 500→404, and
both archive/restore absent pins 403→404.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): gate preferences routes on collection access (purses-55c)

GET /api/collections/[id]/preferences/items and POST …/recalculate were
requireAuth-only; results were caller-scoped so a non-member silently got an
empty 200 and an absent collection 200+[]. Both now run requireApiCollectionAccess
before the controller call → 404 absent, 403 non-member (still caller-scoped for
members). Flipped GET absent 200→404 + stranger 200→403, recalculate absent
200→404, and added recalculate stranger 200→403 + no-row.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): PR1 review fixes — restore 404 symmetry + stale test headers

Adversarial review (security + QA): (1) collections/[id]/restore now uses findById
(matching archive) so a soft-deleted collection → 404 not 403 (§3.4 oracle posture);
(2) corrected stale file-header comments in preferences/invitations integration tests
that misdescribed the now-fixed routes.

Refs: purses-3al, purses-55c, purses-nj7

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(api): mark IDOR holes closed (pv9 PR1) in API.md authz model + Known-gaps

Refs: purses-3al, purses-55c, purses-nj7

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* chore(graphify): refresh graph after pv9 PR1 (IDOR hotfix)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* test(e2e): item-removal (3) verifies survival via DB, not non-member API read

PR1 correctly makes GET /api/items/[id] return 403 for a non-member (IDOR fix), so
the non-owner can no longer read the item to prove it survived. Verify the item row
straight from the DB (mirrors the existing resultItemRowCount check). 4/4 pass locally.

Refs: purses-3al

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
